limitations: The original 60-case Phase 5 measurement remains historical. This release runs a separately identified 11-case acceptance subset covering all nine lanes and disabled search.
The one live grounding fallback is the expected deterministic disabled-search status, with zero writer attempts and checked current-turn provenance.
Physical-GPU and disposable-database application integration suites remain opt-in and are explicitly skipped; the separate native runtime release has actual CPU/GPU oracle evidence.
The existing GPU 0 mbe-gpu memory restriction remains; that backend is admitted on GPU 1.
diagnostics: Initial Studio fixtures inherited the development capture path; the isolated rerun passed all 82 tests.
The first combined Python collection used the app interpreter for numerical-library tests; separate component interpreters passed.
An initial agent run inherited development LLM=false and failed two adapter-settings tests. Clean settings passed those tests and are used by all final batches.
The clean serial agent run was interrupted to run the same collected suite in four independent batches. Every collected test is accounted for exactly once in final totals.

The first new disabled-search smoke case encoded zero allowed operation alternatives instead of one allowed empty set. Its response was correct; the corrected case and all other acceptance cases passed. Original reports and fixture are retained.
deployment: Promotion still requires gm-env begin-testing, verify-testing, and promote --push. The controller records the exact promoted commit, verified data backup and health result outside Git.
